reason: The proof-storage hold (18 and 25 Aug 2026) waiting on a WagerTech alternate solution is real and no Jira ticket records it. But the claim's Jira framing is out of date: WAGR-32 is Done and its 29 Jul comment says the client confirmed GCP on 20 Jul. WAGR-112 (Drive POC) and WAGR-113 (client prerequisites) already track the storage work as 'Awaiting Client Feedback'. The 15 Jul inbound-API idea was overtaken by the GCP/Drive go-ahead (20 Jul to 4 Aug). The URL-field bridge works today, so the gap is mostly a tracking problem.
q1: Found. All 4 transcript quotes from the 3 cited docs (fetched from Drive again) are in the source text. The L0977/L0978 Kobi/Emily segments are taken from the middle of longer lines, with a speaker prefix added and 'um/uh' removed. The wording is unchanged, so they count as found-with-minor-filler-differences. L1931 and L2113 match word for word after normalization. The L0846 (7 Jul) doc was not fetched again because it is only context evidence.
q2: Mostly supported. On 15 Jul, Emily asked to pause GCP while WagerTech scoped its own fraud-detection or proof tool, and said they were 'leaning towards sending them information through the API'. This was a leaning, not a decision, and Emily promised an answer 'by next week'. On 18 Aug, Joyce said 'we might have an alternate solution... TBD', and Kobi put proofs on hold, with reps pasting links in Salesforce for now. On 25 Aug, Kobi restated the hold ('you're going to take that back and get back to us'), with URL fields used for now, and Joyce agreed. No later sentence in those meetings walks this back. The claim joins the 18 Aug alternate solution to the 15 Jul inbound-API idea, but the 18 Aug transcript does not say what the alternate solution is. That link is an inference.
q3: No later meeting resolves it. Between the cited meetings, the decision moved toward GCP/Drive: L1160 (21 Jul) the client wants GCP; L1548/L1553 (4 Aug) Drive POC go-ahead; L1606/L1887 (11 and 18 Aug) internal POC. This means the 15 Jul inbound-API idea did not hold at that time. After 25 Aug, the ledger shows no decision on the alternate solution or on storage. Later proof items (L2312 1 Sep, L2957 23 Sep, L3223 28 Sep) cover only URL-field and proof-status UI. L2019 (19 Aug) confirms the hold, timing unknown. L2037 (19 Aug, tier2) says the client gave a thumbs up on the storage-proofs estimate, but that was before or at the time of the hold and does not reverse it.
q4: Partly covered. WAGR-32 (live: Done, resolved 14 Sep 2026, unassigned, 2 comments). Its description still has the GCP open question, but comment 10409 (29 Jul) says the client confirmed GCP on 20 Jul, the URL-field bridge was delivered, and the build is gated on client prerequisites. The claim's statement that the only open question still frames it as GCP sign-off ignores this comment, and a Done ticket is the wrong anchor. WAGR-112 BUILD-93 Google Drive POC (live: Requirements, custom Status 'Awaiting Client Feedback', unassigned, 1 comment). Its 10 Aug comment says 'APPROVED TO PROCEED' and does not show the 18 Aug hold or the WagerTech alternate solution. WAGR-113 BUILD-94 client prerequisites (Requirements, Awaiting Client Feedback, 0 comments). WAGR-31 Epic H (Open, 0 comments). WAGR-362 Dropbox migration (Open). JQL for proof/storage/GCP/Google Drive, and for alternate solution/on hold/proof URL/fraud detection/proof API, returned no ticket that records the 18/25 Aug hold, WagerTech's alternate solution, an owner or date for that decision, or an inbound proof API. WAGR-443 (out-of-scope holding pen) and WAGR-475 (Nov 1 scope freeze) do not mention proofs.
corrections: Use WAGR-112 (BUILD-93 Drive POC, Awaiting Client Feedback) as the main Jira key, plus WAGR-113, instead of WAGR-32, which is Done.
The WAGR-32 quote is out of date: comment 10409 (2026-07-29) says GCP was confirmed by the client on 2026-07-20.

Change the 'what_differs' text: Jira does track the storage build as waiting on the client. What is missing is the 18/25 Aug hold, WagerTech's alternate-solution decision (owner and date), and the stale 'APPROVED TO PROCEED' state on WAGR-112.
Mark the inbound-API part as an inference: the 15 Jul leaning was overtaken by the GCP/Drive choice, and the 18 Aug alternate solution has no stated design.
Suggested action: add a comment on WAGR-112/WAGR-31, or a decision ticket, that records the hold and the owner. Also consider the hold in the WAGR-475 Nov 1 scope re-plan.
